label: Buoi 6 - Giam sat & Dieu khien
info:
Buoi 6 - de bai muc do 3 cua buoi 5 (lop thay Thanh), bo key moi.

CHANNEL CAM BIEN (DIEN_CHANNEL_ID_CAM_BIEN_CUA_BAN - buoi_6_channel_1): Pi ghi HTTP moi 20s
    field1 Temperature | field2 Humidity | field3 Voltage | field4 Distance
    Web chi DOC (ve 2 do thi + 4 o gia tri moi nhat).

CHANNEL LENH (DIEN_CHANNEL_ID_LENH_CUA_BAN - buoi_6_channel_2): Web ghi, Pi doc HTTP polling 1s
    field1 LED | field2 Relay | field3 Buzzer | field4 Mode

PHAN CHIA GIAO THUC (bat buoc theo de muc do 3):
    "Nut nhan chon che do phai su dung giao thuc MQTT;
     nut nhan dieu khien phai su dung giao thuc HTTP."
    -> MQTT: Auto, Manual                      (nhom 5a)
    -> HTTP: LED / Relay / Buzzer Bat va Tat   (nhom 5b)

DIEU KIEN CHE DO AUTO (giu nguyen theo de):
    LED    sang 18h-22h
    Buzzer keu khi nhiet do > 40C, tat khi < 30C, giua giu nguyen
    Relay  dong khi do am  > 70%, tat khi < 40%, giua giu nguyen

Vi sao tach 2 channel: ThingSpeak chi cho ghi 1 lan/~17s tren MOI channel.
De chung thi Pi ghi cam bien moi 20s se chiem gan het khe ghi, nut HTTP hau
nhu khong chen duoc. Tach ra thi channel LENH luon ranh -> bam nut an ngay.

Vi sao Pi khong subscribe MQTT: ThingSpeak chi cap 1 bo danh tinh MQTT cho
moi channel (client_id = username). Neu ca Web va Pi cung mo ket noi bang
chung client_id thi broker da nhau lien tuc. Nen chi Web giu ket noi MQTT;
Pi doc bang HTTP polling 1s - van nhan du ca 8 nut vi ThingSpeak luu chung
moi lan ghi (du giao thuc nao) vao cung 1 feed.
